title: CanonicalEvent
description: A canonical ledger event. All events appended to *.audit.jsonl files MUST conform to this schema.

event_id.description: Globally unique event ID. Format: EVT-YYYYMMDDHHmmSS-XXXXXXXX

source.description: Component that emitted this event (e.g. phase14_live_fire, verify_constitution).

payload.description: Event-specific data. Shape depends on event_type.

correlation_id.description: Links this event to a run_id, trace_id, or decision_id.

schema_version.description: Schema version used when this event was written.
